versions.changelog:
Initial release of the uview-ui skill.

- Provides skill documentation and component reference for uView UI 2.x, the uni-app Vue 2 component library.
- Includes auto-triggering for scenarios involving uni-app Vue 2 page development, use of uView components, and common mobile UI needs.
- Offers detailed component and tool function indexes, quick links to documentation, and usage scenarios.
- Adds ready-to-use Vue sample code for typical components, such as buttons and forms.
- Helps quickly find API properties, events, and guides for both components and utility functions.
